review: WAVE 2 expanded screening supersedes the limited WAVE 1 contact assessment. Three millimetres is a review trigger, not a clinical threshold. Rejection can also follow smaller contacts in small structures. Conservative non-acceptance does not assert all rejected interfaces are equally severe.
